meta.note: All frames 1x. Load spritesheets with frameWidth/frameHeight; props are single images.

heroComposer.note: Heroes are composited at runtime (or baked per save) from layers. Bake with MV.frames("hero:<class>:<skin>:<hair>:<hairColour>:<eyes>:<eyeColour>:<expression>:<mark>:<nohat 0|1>:<body 0 female|1 male>", "idle"|"walk").
heroComposer.bob: Upper body shifts -1px on idle_1 and pass frames; the hip rows 33-36 are stretched so no gap shows.

body.female: Head base HEAD. 1px lashes at the outer top corner of each eye. Blush on unless the expression is Stern.
body.male: Head base HEAD_M (wider jaw and neck). Eyes drop the top row (no glint), 4px brows in the hair shade, no blush. Stubble and Beard marks use the hair colour.

heroComposer.capped: When a class has closed headgear (no `open` flag), Spiky hair drops its spikes so nothing pokes through the hat.
heroComposer.equipRules: Chest armour replaces the class body and its back gear. A helm replaces the class headgear. Gloves recolour the skin of the hands. Boots recolour the feet. A weapon replaces every class hand-held item. Dye shifts the hue of the class outfit and leaves skin and hair alone.

tilesV2.autotileIndex: TL*8 + TR*4 + BL*2 + BR (1 = inside terrain). Paint on a corner grid offset by half a tile.

weapons.rows: sword, axe, mace, spear, bow, staff, dagger, wand
weapons.columns_are: wood, iron, steel, ember, rime, storm, umbral, sparkforged

armour.rows: 96 sets: 12 schools × 8 styles (cloth, leather, fur, mail, robe, scale, plate, vestment)
armour.bonusRules: 2 pieces: style stat. 4 pieces: ability, where the style picks the trigger and the school picks the effect. Attuned: an extra bonus when the wearer’s class belongs to the same school.
